blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We present Depth Pro 2, an approach to estimating dense metric depth for images and video at full resolution. By analyzing prior methods for monocular depth estimation, we find that they commonly trade off temporal consistency and boundary sharpness: multi-frame methods favor consistency, single-frame methods favor sharpness. To overcome this trade-off, we train a single, scalable network that processes both images and video and predicts depth maps at native resolution. Depth Pro 2 produces depth maps that are metrically accurate, sharp, and temporally consistent all at once, outperforming prior work in all of these dimensions. We release a family of models that define a new Pareto frontier in terms of metric accuracy, sharpness, temporal consistency, and runtime. We release code and weights at https://apple-aiml-research.github.io/ml-depth-pro-2/
blocks.zh: 我们提出深度方案2,这是对图像和视频的密集度进行全分辨率估计的方法。 通过分析先前的单倍深度估计方法,我们发现它们通常与时间一致性和边界锐度进行交换:多帧法有利于一致性,单帧法有利于锐度。 为了克服这种权衡,我们训练一个单一的,可伸缩的网络,处理图像和视频,并以原生分辨率预测深度地图. 深度 Pro 2 绘制出精确度、锐度和时间一致的深度图,一次一次比所有这些方面先前的工作表现好。 我们发布了一组模型,这些模型定义了一个新的帕雷托边疆,在度量精确度,锐度,时间一致性和运行时间等方面. 我们在https://apple-aiml-research.github.io/ml-septh-pro-2/上发布代码和权重.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Consider the meerkat (Figure 1 ). You may have recorded it on a recent holiday and are watching it now on your high-resolution screen. While you admire the sharp details of the meerkat, you find the background leaves distracting and regret not having recorded the video at a shallower depth of field. Applications that synthetically blur the background could help, but to reliably separate the meerkat from its background, they require a depth map for every frame ( Bertalmío et al., 2004 ; Peng et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 考虑一下meerkat(图1). 你也许在最近一个节日录制了它, 并且正在你的高清屏幕上观看它。 虽然你欣赏 尖锐的细节 eerkat, 你发现背景 叶分心 和遗憾 没有录制 视频 在更浅的 深的田。 合成模糊背景的应用可能有所帮助,但为了可靠地将meerkat与其背景区分开来,它们需要每个帧的深度图(Bertalmío等人,2004年;Peng等人,2022年).

blocks.en:
Picking a suitable method for estimating depth from monocular videos is surprisingly difficult. Methods designed for single images can provide high-resolution depth maps with sharp occlusion boundaries. InfiniDepth ( Yu et al., 2026 ) , for instance, reasonably delineates the fur (third column of Figure 1 ). Yet its predictions are temporally inconsistent as it processes each frame separately and places the meerkat at different distances over time.
A method designed for video, such as π 3 \pi^{3} ( Wang et al., 2026b ) , reliably places the meerkat at a consistent distance across frames (last column of Figure 1 ). But it operates at a lower resolution than the input video, which smooths over the fur.
blocks.zh:
从单人视频中选择一个适当的方法来估计深度,这令人惊讶。 为单一图像设计的方法可以提供带有尖锐的隔离边界的高分辨率深度地图. 例如,Infini Depth(Yu等人,2026年)合理划定了毛皮(图1第三栏)。 然而,它的预测在时间上是不一致的,因为它将每个框架分开处理,并随着时间推移将元卡置于不同的距离。
一种为视频设计的方法,例如 ^ 3\pi^{3}(Wang et al., 2026b),可靠地将meerkat置于一个一致的跨帧距离(图1最后一栏). 但其运行的分辨率低于输入视频,在皮毛上平滑.

blocks.en:
This trade-off between sharp boundaries and temporal consistency pervades monocular depth estimation. Figure 2 presents the state of the art on boundary sharpness and temporal consistency, measured over the Sintel and Spring datasets ( Butler et al., 2012 ; Mehl et al., 2023 ) . (We choose these datasets for their dense, high-resolution ground truth on video sequences.) We find that single-image methods cluster at the top left and multi-frame methods cluster at the bottom right. That is, depth maps from single-image methods feature the sharpest boundaries but are unstable over time, while depth maps from multi-frame methods are stable but overly smooth.
Multi-frame approaches are commonly optimized for stability through temporal attention over many frames ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2026b ) , video diffusion priors ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Shao et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025b ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) , and video training data ( Wang et al., 2023 ) . This biases the methods towards longer temporal context and costly diffusion, which require substantial resources (memory and runtime) and necessitate operating at reduced resolution, thus oversmoothing boundaries.
blocks.zh:
这种尖锐的边界和时间一致性之间的权衡,渗透到单体深度估计。 图2显示在Sintel和Spring数据集上测量的边界锐度和时间一致性的最新动态(Butler等人,2012年;Mehl等人,2023年)。 (我们在视频序列上选择这些数据集来表示其密集的高分辨率地面真相). 我们发现左上方的单像方法集群,右下方的多帧方法集群. 也就是说,单一图像方法的深度地图具有最尖锐的界限,但随着时间的推移却不稳定,而多帧方法的深度地图是稳定的,但过于光滑。
多框架方法通常通过对许多框架的时间关注来优化稳定(Wang等人,2025a); Wang等人,2026b),视频传播前科(Hu等人,2025;Shao等人,2025;Yang等人,2025b;Zhang等人,2026),视频培训数据(Wang等人,2023). 这种做法使方法偏向于较长的时间背景和昂贵的传播,这需要大量资源(记忆和运行时间),并需要降低分辨率,从而过度疏远边界。

blocks.en:
In this paper, we present Depth Pro 2, a method that estimates sharp, metric, and temporally consistent depth from monocular images and video.
Depth Pro 2 outperforms both single-image and multi-frame methods in boundary sharpness and temporal consistency (see Figure 2 ), as well as in metric depth accuracy (see Section 4 ).
The key idea is an architecture that processes a flexible number of frames jointly at their native resolution. The joint processing stabilizes depth temporally. Operating at native resolution preserves sharp boundaries.
In contrast to training with complex multi-stage curricula ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Chou et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2023 ) , we train Depth Pro 2 on clips of 1 to 32 frames, mixing image, video, and multi-view datasets. By training on single images alongside video, Depth Pro 2 learns to infer metric scale from individual frames. By training on videos with a temporal consistency loss, it learns to keep its estimates stable across frames.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们提出了深度Pro 2, 这个方法从单视图像和视频中估算出尖锐的,度量的和时间上一致的深度.
深度Pro 2在边界锐度和时间一致性方面(见图2),以及测量深度精确度方面(见第4节),都超过了单图像和多帧方法。
关键的想法是建立一个架构,在它们本土的分辨率下,共同处理一些灵活的框架。 联合加工暂时稳定深度. 以原生分辨率运作保持了尖锐的界限。
与采用复杂多阶段课程的培训(Chen等人,2025年;Chou等人,2025年;Lin等人,2026年;Wang等人,2023年)形成对比的是,我们对深度Pro 2进行1到32帧的剪辑,混合图像,视频,多视图数据集的培训. 通过对单幅图像和视频的培训,Depth Pro 2学习从单个帧中推断出度量尺度. 通过对视频进行时间一致性损失的培训,它学会保持其跨帧估计的稳定。

blocks.en:
Depth Pro 2 predicts inverse depth normalized by the focal length, and uses the focal length of input images to recover metric depth ( Bochkovskii et al., 2025 ; Yin et al., 2023a ) . To reliably estimate metric depth when the focal length is not provided, we train a focal length estimator, following Depth Pro ( Bochkovskii et al., 2025 ) . In contrast to Depth Pro, however, we design our focal length estimator to be lightweight to facilitate streaming video processing.
Our focal length estimator runs at 118 fps at 1080p on a B200 and is more accurate than prior estimators.
blocks.zh:
深度Pro 2预测了焦距正常化的反向深度,并利用输入图像的焦距恢复度量深度(Bochkovskii等人,2025年;Yin等人,2023年a). 为了可靠地估计在未提供焦距时的测量深度,我们按照“深度方案”(Bochkovskii等人,2025年)培训一个焦距估计器。 然而与深度Pro相比,我们设计了焦距估计器,以轻量级来方便流媒体处理.
我们的焦距估测器在B200上以118英尺/秒1080p运行,比之前的估测器更准确.

blocks.en:
To support a broad set of applications that may vary in the relative importance of accuracy and latency, we release a family of models ranging from 24M to 872M parameters.
In the streaming setting, where frames arrive one at a time, our smallest model (Depth Pro 2-S) runs at 53 fps at 1080p on a B200 (Figure 12 ), faster than the 30 fps at which most videos are recorded. Our largest model (Depth Pro 2-H + ) runs at 8 fps on 1080p video and outperforms all prior work in terms of metric depth, boundary sharpness, and temporal consistency, on both images and video (Section 4 ).
blocks.zh:
为了支持一系列广泛的应用,这些应用在精确度和耐久度的相对重要性上可能有所不同,我们释放出一组从24M到872M参数不等的模型.
在流线设定中,帧一次到达一个时,我们最小的模型(Depth Pro 2-S)以53 fps,1080p运行在B200(图12)上,比记录大多数视频的30 fps更快. 我们最大的模型(深度Pro 2-H + )在1080p的视频上以8英尺的高度运行,在图像和视频上在度量深度、边界锐度和时间一致性(第4节)方面超越了以前所有的工作。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Zero-shot metric depth. Early work trained on single-domain datasets with known camera intrinsics for domain-specific metric depth prediction ( Eigen et al., 2014 ; Eigen & Fergus, 2015 ; Liu et al., 2016 ) . Ranftl et al. (2022) ; Ranftl et al. (2021) pioneered training on diverse cross-domain mixtures of datasets for generalist monocular depth estimation. While this substantially increased generality and enabled zero-shot deployment across domains, their formulation relaxed the estimated depth from metric to relative.
Subsequent work focused on recovering metric depth while retaining strong generalist performance ( Yin et al., 2023b ; Yin et al., 2023a ) . One line of work developed approaches for handling arbitrary camera models ( Piccinelli et al., 2024 ; Piccinelli et al., 2025b ; Piccinelli et al., 2025a ) .
Another predicted point clouds to supervise via depth-affine losses ( Wang et al., 2025c ; Wang et al., 2025d ; Kong et al., 2026 ) . MetricAnything pretrained on large-scale diverse depth completion to forego reasoning about camera intrinsics ( Ma et al., 2026 ) .
Depth Pro demonstrated strong metric depth estimation through a separate field-of-view estimator, which can be trained without any depth supervision ( Bochkovskii et al., 2025 ) .
We build on the Depth Pro approach and train a lightweight field-of-view estimator that outperforms prior work while substantially reducing the estimator’s size to enable accurate field-of-view and metric depth estimation at high frame rates.
blocks.zh:
零射量度深度. 早期工作培训为单域数据集,已知的相机内含,用于特定域的计量深度预测(Eigen等人,2014年;Eigen & Fergus,2015年;Liu等人,2016年)。 Ranftl 等人(2022年);Ranftl 等人(2021年)率先就各种数据集的跨域混合物进行培训,以便进行通用单体深度估计。 虽然这大大提高了普遍性,并使得能够在各个领域零发部署,但其配制将估计深度从度量放宽到相对。
随后的工作重点是恢复测量深度,同时保持强通论表现(Yin等人,2023年b; Yin等人, 2023a ). 一项工作是制定处理任意照相机模型的办法(Piccinelli等人,2024年;Piccinelli等人,2025年b;Piccinelli等人,2025年a) 。
另一预测点云通过深度甲胺损失进行监督(Wang等人,2025c;Wang等人,2025d;Kong等人,2026). 在大规模多样深度的完成上预先进行测量,以放弃对照相机内在特性的推理(Ma等人,2026年)。
深度评估方案通过一个单独的视野估计器展示了强有力的计量深度估计,可以在没有任何深度监督的情况下对其进行培训(Bochkovskii等人,2025年)。
我们利用“深度方案”的方法,并训练一个比先前工作成绩好的轻量级视场估计器,同时大幅度缩小视场估计器的规模,以便能够以高帧率准确的视场和度量深度估计。

blocks.en:
Sharp depth. A line of work processes images in tiles at multiple scales to obtain sharper depth predictions ( Bochkovskii et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2024a ; Li et al., 2024b ; Li et al., 2026 ; Miangoleh et al., 2021 ) . Kong et al. (2026) lift point estimates into sparse voxels and apply sparse 3D convolutions to iteratively refine local geometry and sharpness. Yu et al. (2026) represent depth as a neural implicit field that can be queried at arbitrary resolution, but require sparse metric depth as additional input to predict dense metric depth. He et al. (2026) ; Ke et al. (2024) ; Pavlovic et al. (2026) leverage latent diffusion priors and synthetic training data for predicting sharp depth boundaries. To avoid artifacts from decoding latents, Xu et al. (2025) denoise in pixel space through a cascade of diffusion transformers.
In contrast to prior work that combines multiple scales or iteratively refines predictions, Depth Pro 2 predicts sharp boundaries at native resolution via a single pass through a vision transformer.
blocks.zh:
尖锐的深度。 工作线在多个尺度上处理瓷砖中的图像,以获得更尖锐的深度预测(Bochkovskii等人,2025年;Li等人,2024年a; Li等人,2024b;Li等人,2026;Miangoleh等人,2021). 金刚等. (2026年)提升点估计为稀疏的阴道,并应用稀疏的3D演化来迭代精炼局部几何和锐度. Yu等人(2026年)作为神经内含的字段表示深度,可以任意解析来询问,但作为预测密度深度的额外投入,需要稀疏的度量深度. 他等人(2026年);Ke等人(2024年);Pavlovic等人(2026年)利用潜在扩散前科和合成培训数据预测尖深边界。 为了避免文物被解码潜伏,徐等人(2025年)通过扩散变压器的级联,在像素空间中登基.
与之前结合多个尺度或迭代精炼预测的作品形成对比的是,深度Pro 2通过单传透视变压器在原生分辨率上预测尖锐的边界.

blocks.en:
Stable depth. Single-image methods are inconsistent when applied to individual video frames separately. To produce consistent depth maps over video sequences, researchers have proposed specialized modules ( Piccinelli et al., 2026 ; Chou et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Zhang et al., 2019 ) , plug-and-play stabilization ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , and spatiotemporal heads ( Chen et al., 2025 ) .
Another line of work fine-tunes video diffusion models for temporally consistent depth prediction ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Shao et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025b ) , or adapts them into deterministic single-step regressors ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
Instead of relying on custom modules or computationally heavy video diffusion priors, we adapt a single-image vision transformer (ViT) ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2021 ) to handle a flexible number of frames and penalize inconsistency between predictions during training.
blocks.zh:
稳定深度。 单幅图像方法在单独应用于单个视频帧时不一致. 为了在视频序列上制作一致的深度地图,研究人员提出了专门的模块(Piccinelli等人,2026年;Chou等人,2025年;Wang等人,2025年b;Zhang等人,2019年b),插图和游戏稳定化(Wang等人,2023年),以及spatimporal head(Chen等人,2025年).
另一条工作线微调视频传播模型,用于时间上一致的深度预测(Hu等人,2025年;Shao等人,2025年;Yang等人,2025年b),或将其改编为决定性单步递减器(Zhang等人,2026年).
与其依赖自定义模块或计算重的视频传播前身,不如改用单像视变压器(ViT)(Dosovitskiy等人,2021年)来处理灵活数量的帧,并处罚训练期间预测之间的不一致.

blocks.en:
Another line of work takes inspiration from classic 3D reconstruction and optimizes depth jointly with camera poses ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Lin et al., 2026 ) .
To improve the consistency of reconstructed geometry, these methods are commonly optimized for handling large sets of views, which in turn limits their ability to process images at high resolution, a key requirement for producing sharp depth maps.
blocks.zh:
另一行工作从经典的立体重建中汲取灵感,并与相机的姿势共同优化深度(Wang等人,2024年;Wang等人,2025a); Wang等人,2026a;Wang等人,2026b;Lin等人,2026).
为了提高重建几何的一致性,这些方法通常被优化用于处理大组观点,这反过来又限制了它们高分辨率处理图像的能力,这是制作尖深地图的关键要求.

blocks.en:
In contrast, Depth Pro 2 estimates metric depth from a flexible number of input frames and processes them at native resolution to produce significantly sharper occlusion boundaries.
To enable processing of multiple images, we simply adapt a subset of the self-attention layers of our transformer to attend over tokens from multiple views without introducing additional parameters.
Variants of this idea have been used in video transformers ( Bertasius et al., 2021 ; Arnab et al., 2021 ) , multi-view recognition ( Chen et al., 2021 ; Lee et al., 2025 ) , and generation ( Khachatryan et al., 2023 ; Shi et al., 2024 ) .
Most closely related, Depth Anything 3 ( Lin et al., 2026 ) rearranges tokens so that pretrained DINOv2 attention operates across views for feed-forward reconstruction.
Unlike these approaches, we design our network to predict metric depth at native resolution.
blocks.zh:
与此相对照,深度Pro 2从灵活数量的输入框中估算出测量深度,并在原生分辨率下进行处理,以产生显著的更尖锐的隔离边界.
为了能够处理多个图像,我们只是调整了我们变压器的自留心层的一个子集,从多个视图中将符号放在上面,而不引入额外的参数.
这一想法的变体被用于视频变压器(Bertasius等人,2021年;Arnab等人,2021年),多视图识别(Chen等人,2021年;Lee等人,2025年),以及生成(Khachatryan等人,2023年;Shi等人,2024年).
最紧密的关联,深度任意 3 (Lin et al., 2026) 重新排列符号,以便预先训练的DINOv2注意力在视图中运行,用于饲料前进重建.
与这些方法不同,我们设计了我们的网络,以预测本地分辨率的度量深度。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Architecture
blocks.zh: 3.1 建筑

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Depth Pro 2 Architecture. Our depth estimation network consists of a multi-view transformer that ingests one or multiple input frames and processes them jointly, and a DPT decoder, which predicts an inverse depth map per input frame. 1 The transformer alternates attention within and across frames. 2 Features for fusion by the DPT decoder are extracted at intermediate layers. Table 1 details layer configurations for each model of the Depth Pro 2 family.
blocks.zh: 图3:深度Pro 2架构. 我们的深度估计网络包括一个摄入一个或多个输入帧并联合处理的多视图变压器,以及一个预测每个输入帧反向深度图的DPT解码器. 页:1 变压器在帧内和帧间互换注意. 2 DPT解码器的聚变特性在中间层提取. 表1详细列出了深度Pro 2家族的每个模型的层配置.

blocks.en:
Overview. The architecture of Depth Pro 2 is depicted in Fig. 3 . It consists of a multi-view transformer that ingests a single image or multiple frames of a video, processes them jointly, and decodes them to an inverse depth map per input image or video frame.
Following Depth Pro, our depth estimation network predicts inverse depth normalized by focal length, and we combine it with a known or estimated focal length to predict metric depth ( Bochkovskii et al., 2025 ) .
A separate field-of-view estimator processes the input image(s) and predicts the field-of-view per image, which we convert to the focal length. If the focal length is known a priori, e.g., through EXIF data, we use that instead of running the field-of-view estimator.
blocks.zh:
概览. 深度Pro 2的架构在图3中描绘. 它由一个多视图变压器组成,该变压器摄入一个视频的单个图像或多个帧,将其联合处理,并解码为每个输入图像或视频帧的反向深度图.
根据深度方案,我们的深度估计网络预测反向深度按焦距正常化,我们将其与已知或估计焦距相结合,以预测度量深度(Bochkovskii等人,2025年)。
一个单独的视野估计器处理输入图像,并预测每个图像的视野,我们转换成焦距. 如果焦距是先验的,例如通过EXIF数据,我们使用这个线程,而不是运行视野估计器。

blocks.en:
Lightweight multi-frame depth estimation network. We design our depth estimation network to be lightweight and to flexibly handle a variable number of images, starting from a ViT variant pretrained for single-image processing ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2021 ; Siméoni et al., 2026 ) .
Since temporal stability requires an architecture that aligns predictions across frames, our model shares information across jointly processed frames via cross-attention, alternating blocks of within-frame self-attention and cross-frame attention ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Lin et al., 2026 ) . (See Fig. 3 , 1 .)
Since early blocks in multi-view transformers tend to encode low-level features and only later blocks approximate feature matching ( Starý et al., 2026 ) , we restrict the first 1 / 3 1/3 of the L L transformer blocks to self-attention operating only over tokens from the same frame for higher efficiency. The remaining 2 ​ L / 3 2L/3 blocks alternate between within- and cross-frame attention.
When encoding spatial positions of tokens processed by the transformer, we specifically omit any encoding of frame order, making our network equivariant to frame permutation.
This allows flexible processing of any number of frames and directly reusing the attention weights from single-image pretrained encoder checkpoints ( Lin et al., 2026 ) without adding transformer blocks that need to be trained from scratch for multi-view processing.
blocks.zh:
轻量级多帧深度估计网. 我们设计我们的深度估计网络是轻量级的,可以灵活处理可变数量的图像,从一个预先训练用于单像处理的ViT变体开始(Dosovitskiy等人,2021年;Siméoni等人,2026年)。
由于时间稳定性需要一种结构,对跨框架的预测进行调和,因此我们的模型通过跨意向、相互交替的框内自觉和跨框注意力共享信息(Wang等人,2025a); Lin et al., 2026 (英语). (见图3, 1)
由于多视变压器中的早期区块倾向于编码低级特性,只有后来的区块大致特征匹配(Starý等人,2026年),我们限制L变压器区块的前1 / 3 1/3的自觉操作只从同一个架构架上运行标语,以提高效率. 其余2个L / 3 2L/3区块在跨范围注意之间交替排列.
在对变压器处理的令牌空间位置进行编码时,我们特别省略了帧顺序的任何编码,使我们的网络等效于帧定压.
这样可以灵活处理任意数量的帧,直接重用单像预训编码器检查站的注意重量(Lin等人,2026年),而不增加需要从头开始训练的变压器块进行多视处理.

blocks.en:
Native resolution processing. Boundary sharpness correlates with the resolution at which frames are processed ( Miangoleh et al., 2021 ; Bochkovskii et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2026 ) . We therefore design Depth Pro 2 to operate at the full native resolution of the input image or video. To this end, we initialize our multi-view transformer from DINOv3 weights, as DINOv3 is trained specifically to produce dense, high-resolution features ( Siméoni et al., 2026 ) .
An input image is split into patches of size
16, and each patch is embedded as a token. We encode each token’s spatial position through a 2D rotary embedding over their coordinates. Instead of normalizing coordinates per axis ( Siméoni et al., 2026 ) , which would discard any information about the image’s aspect ratio, we divide both axes by the longer side. The position ( x , y ) (x,y) of a patch ( i , j ) (i,j) within a grid of size h × w h\times w is thus y ′ = 2 ​ ( i + 1 2 ) / max ⁡ ( h , w ) − 1 , x ′ = 2 ​ ( j + 1 2 ) / max ⁡ ( h , w ) − 1 . y^{\prime}=2(i+\tfrac{1}{2})/\max(h,w)-1,\quad x^{\prime}=2(j+\tfrac{1}{2})/\max(h,w)-1.
blocks.zh:
原生分辨率处理. 边界锐度与处理框架的决议有关(Miangoleh等人,2021年;Bochkovskii等人,2025年;Yu等人,2026年)。 因此,我们设计了深度Pro 2,以输入图像或视频的完全本地分辨率运行. 为此,我们从DINOv3重量开始初始化我们的多视图变压器,因为DINOv3经过专门训练,可以产生密集的高分辨率特性(Siméoni等人,2026年).
输入图像分割为大小的补丁
16,每个补丁被嵌入作为符号. 我们通过在座标上嵌入2D旋转器来编码每个信使的空间位置。 Siméoni等人(2026年)将丢弃任何有关图像侧面比的信息, 因此,在大小h×(j,j)的网格内,补丁(i,j,j)的位置(x,y)为y=2(i + 1 2)/最大⁡(h,w)-1,x=2(j + 1 2)/最大⁡(h,w)-1. y=prime=2(i+\tfrac{1}{2})/\max(h,w)-1,quad x^{\prime}=2(j+\tfrac{1}{2})/\max(h,w)-1.

blocks.en:
DPT decoder. A DPT decoder ( Ranftl et al., 2021 ) decodes features extracted per frame into inverse depth maps. (See Fig. 3 , 2 .)
Following DPT, we extract tokens after several transformer blocks, assemble them into feature maps at different resolutions, and project them to a common channel dimension.
Depending on the size of the multi-view transformer, we adjust the positions at which we extract features, and scale the number of channel dimensions the decoder operates on. See Table 1 for the exact specification.
To upsample feature maps within the decoder, we replace bilinear upsampling with transposed convolutions ( Bochkovskii et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
DPT解码器. 一种DPT解码器(Ranftl等人,2021年)将每个帧提取的特性解码为反向深度图. (见图3、2)
继DPT之后,我们在几个变压器块后提取符号,以不同的分辨率组装成特征地图,并投影到一个共同的通道维度.
根据多视图变压器的大小,我们调整提取特性的位置,并缩放解码器运行的通道维数. 具体规格见表1。
为了在解码器内对特征图进行上标,我们用转录图(Bochkovskii等人,2025年)取代双线式上标图。

blocks.en:
Focal length estimation. Our multi-view transformer predicts inverse depth normalized by the focal length ( Bochkovskii et al., 2025 ) . Converting this prediction to metric depth therefore requires the focal length. The focal length is often recorded in EXIF metadata; when it is not, we estimate it with a separate, lightweight vision transformer. This estimator predicts the field of view along the shorter image side, from which the focal length follows given the length of that side in pixels. To minimize the overhead, we build the estimator on DINOv3 ViT-S/16 ( Siméoni et al., 2026 ) and fine-tune it end-to-end on Flickr photographs with EXIF focal lengths ( Thomee et al., 2016 ) . The estimator has 23.5M parameters and, for a 1080p frame, adds about 8%, 3%, 1%, and 0.5% to the compute of Depth Pro 2-S, Depth Pro 2-B, Depth Pro 2-L, and Depth Pro 2-H + , respectively.
For multi-view input, we assume a constant focal length and take the median of the per-frame estimates.
On the zero-shot benchmark of Bochkovskii et al. (2025) , our estimator attains a mean δ 25 \delta_{25} of 88.6%, compared to 71.7% for Depth Pro (Table 6 ).
Appendix A.2 describes the training setup, Appendix E.4 analyzes design choices, and Table 6 compares the estimator to prior work.
blocks.zh:
焦距估计. 我们的多视变速器预测的反向深度由焦距正常化(Bochkovskii等人,2025年)。 因此,将这一预测转换为度量深度需要焦距。 焦距常记录在EXIF元数据中;如果没有焦距,我们用单独的轻量级视变器来估计. 这个估计器沿较短的图像侧面预示了视场,从这个侧面的像素长度来看,焦距跟随它. 为了尽可能减少间接费用,我们在DINov3 VIT-S/16(Siméoni等人,2026年)上搭建了估算器,并在Flickr照片上用EXIF的焦距对其进行端到端的微调(Thomee等人,2016年). 估计器有23.5M参数,对于一个1080p帧,在深度Pro2-S,深度Pro2-B,深度Pro2-L,深度Pro2-H+的计算中分别增加了约8%,3%,1%和0.5%.
对于多视图输入,我们假设一个恒定焦距,并取每帧估计值的中位数.
根据Bochkovskii等人(2025年)的零射线基准,我们的估算值是25\delta\25}的平均值,为88.6%,而深度Pro为71.7%(表6)。

blocks.en: 3.2 Training
blocks.zh: 3.2 培训

blocks.en:
Training data. Depth Pro 2 is trained on a diverse set of 19 datasets with a strong focus on synthetic ground truth. See Table 7 for the full list.
To preserve the sharpness of ground-truth depth maps, we avoid any interpolation of ground-truth depth during training, as averaging over depth discontinuities breeds flying pixels ( Bochkovskii et al., 2025 ) .
To expose our model to a broad set of image sizes and aspect ratios, we crop and sample images at varying strides.
During training, we use ground-truth camera intrinsics (focal length) and adjust accordingly depending on how we crop or subsample.
Controlled experiments in the supplement (Section E ) show that training without resampling improves boundary accuracy by more than 5 percentage points over Depth Pro’s resizing.
blocks.zh:
培训数据。 Depth Pro 2则在一套多样化的19个数据集上接受训练,并大力关注合成地面真理. 完整名单见表7。
为了保持地面真实深度图的清晰度,我们避免在训练期间对地面真实深度进行任何内插,因为平均在深度不连续时会产生飞行像素(Bochkovskii等人,2025年)。
为了使我们的模型暴露在广泛的图像大小和侧面比上,我们以不同的速度对图像进行裁剪和取样。
在训练期间,我们使用地面真实摄像头内在(焦距),并根据我们如何收割或次级采样作相应调整。
补充材料中受控制的实验(E节)显示,不进行再补充的训练比深度方案调整的精确度提高了5个百分点以上。

blocks.en: To handle both images and video, Depth Pro 2 is trained on clips with varying length, of which all frames are processed jointly. Images are treated as clips of length 1; for video and multi-view datasets, a clip contains up to 32 frames. (We use frame for both video frames and views.) For each clip, we draw the source dataset i i with probability p i ∝ n i 1 / T p_{i}\propto n_{i}^{1/T} , where n i n_{i} is the size of dataset i i and T = 2 T=2 ( Arivazhagan et al., 2019 ) . To avoid overfitting to small datasets, we cap their sampling weight.

blocks.en: 3.3 Inference
blocks.zh: 3.3 推论

blocks.en: Depth Pro 2 is trained on clips of up to 32 frames but at inference time processes videos of arbitrary length. It supports two modes. Buffered streaming accumulates frames into clips and processes each clip with full attention across its frames. Unbuffered streaming produces a depth map for each frame as soon as it arrives, for applications that require minimal latency.
blocks.zh: 深度 Pro 数据 2 培训内容为最多32帧的片段,但推断时间过程为任意长度的视频。 它支持两种模式. 缓冲的流线将框积成片段和过程,每个片段全程注意. 未缓冲的流线在到达后立即为每个帧生成深度图,用于需要最小延迟的应用程序.

blocks.en:
Buffered streaming. For buffered streaming, we divide the video into clips of N N frames, with consecutive clips overlapping by K K frames, and process each clip independently. The overlap keeps predictions consistent across clip boundaries. Within the overlap, we blend the two predictions with weights that change linearly with frame position.
Section E.3 reports controlled experiments on the choice of N N and K K .
blocks.zh:
缓流流. 对于缓冲流线,我们将视频分为N帧的片段,连续片段由K帧重叠,并独立处理每个片段. 重叠使预测在短片边界之间保持一致。 在重叠中,我们把两个预测与线性变化的重量和帧位置混合在一起。
E.3节报告了关于N N和K K的选择的控制实验。

blocks.en: Unbuffered streaming. Unbuffered streaming minimizes per-frame latency. In this mode, Depth Pro 2 processes frames sequentially with causal cross-attention: each frame attends only to itself and to preceding frames. The keys and values of past frames remain fixed as new frames arrive, so we compute them once and keep them in a first-in-first-out (FIFO) cache. Each frame attends to a window of C C frames: itself and the C − 1 C-1 frames before it, the keys and values of which are cached. Only the cross-frame attention layers use this cache; the per-frame layers operate on the current frame alone.
blocks.zh: 无碍流布. 无阻流线最小化每帧空闲度. 在此模式下,深度Pro 2进程框架以因果交叉意向相继进行:每个框架只面向自身和之前的框架. 随着新帧的到来,过去帧的键和值仍然固定不变,所以我们计算一次,并保留在先出(FIFO)缓存中. 每个帧都处理一个 C C 帧的窗口:它本身和它的前面的 C − 1 C-1 帧,其键和值被缓存. 只有跨帧的注意层使用这个缓存;每帧层单独运行在当前的帧上.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented a family of models that estimate sharp and temporally consistent metric depth.
By analyzing prior approaches to monocular depth estimation, we observed a dichotomy between image-based methods that produce sharp depth maps and video-based methods that are temporally stable but elide detail. Depth Pro 2 overcomes this trade-off and provides unprecedented sharpness and temporal stability.

我们提出了一套模型,估计出精确和时间上一致的度量深度。
通过分析以前对单体深度估计的方法,我们观察到了以图像为基础的方法的二分法,这种方法产生尖锐的深度地图,而以视频为基础的方法在时间上是稳定的,但却是精细的。 深度Pro 2克服了这种权衡,提供了前所未有的锐度和时间稳定性.

blocks.en: We release a family of models, each of which processes both single images and video sequences at full resolution, and can process video in a streaming fashion. The smallest model, Depth Pro 2-S, processes streaming 1080p video at 53 fps on a single GPU. The largest model, Depth Pro 2-H + , processes 1080p video at 8 fps and sets the new state of the art on metric depth accuracy, boundary sharpness, and temporal stability all at once.

blocks.en: Token-budget batching. Each GPU has a maximum budget of 73,728 patch tokens during training. Half of the steps use the full native frame. Otherwise, we draw an aspect ratio relative to the native aspect and a short-side limit, then crop to 60–100% of the largest feasible window. Where native resolution permits, we choose spatial stride 2 with probability 0.25, taking every second pixel in both the image and depth. We do not interpolate ground truth to keep fidelity. Each clip uses as many frames as fit in the token budget, up to a separate cap of 32 frames. Remaining capacity is filled with more clips from the same source. The short side of the input video is 608/1024/2048 pixels at 10th/50th/90th percentiles. The sampled aspect ratios are 1.00/1.07/1.50 at the same percentiles.
blocks.zh: 托肯预算批量。 每个GPU在训练期间的最高预算为73,728个补丁符号. 一半的台阶使用完整的本土框架. 否则,我们将绘制一个与原生部分相对的宽度比和短边限制,然后收成到最大可行窗口的60-100%。 在本地分辨率允许的情况下,我们以0.25的概率选择空间步态2,在图像和深度上每秒摄取一个像素。 我们不插上真相来保持忠诚。 每个片段都使用与符号预算相适应的尽可能多的帧,最多可以单独使用32帧的上限. 剩余容量由来自同一来源的更多片段填充. 输入视频的短边为608/1024/2048像素,为10th/50th/90百分位数. 同一百分位数的抽样方面比率为1.00/1.07/1.5。

Since we train at native aspect ratio, image size may vary between batches.
Each GPU therefore fills its batch up to a budget of 147,456 147{,}456 tokens ( 16 × 16 16\times 16 -pixel patches; e.g., 144 photos at 512 × 512 512\times 512 or 96 at 512 × 768 512\times 768 ).

blocks.en: In addition to the results on jitter (Table 5 ), we evaluate our method using the Temporal Alignment Error (TAE), and report results in Table 12 . This evaluation uses the Spring ( Mehl et al., 2023 ) , Sintel ( Butler et al., 2012 ) , ScanNet ( Dai et al., 2017 ) , Bonn ( Palazzolo et al., 2019 ) , and KITTI ( Geiger et al., 2012 ) datasets.
blocks.zh: 除了关于焦急的结果(表5)外,我们还使用时间调整错误(TAE)来评估我们的方法,并在表12中报告结果。 本评价使用Spring(Mehl等人,2023年),Sintel (Butler等人,2012年),ScanNet(Dai等人,2017年),波恩(Palazzolo等人,2019年),以及KITTI(Geiger等人,2012年)数据集.

blocks.en: TAE differs from our jitter metric (Section F.1 ) in the computation of correspondences. While jitter relies on track-based correspondences that account for dynamic objects, TAE reprojects predicted depth between consecutive frames using the ground-truth camera intrinsics and poses, and measures the resulting absolute relative error ( Yang et al., 2025b ) . TAE assumes a static scene and does not account for independently moving objects.
blocks.zh: 在计算通信时,TAE不同于我们的紧张度量(F.1节)。 虽然jitter依赖于记录动态对象的基于轨道的通信,但TAE利用地面真实相机的内在和外形对连续帧之间的深度进行预测,并测量由此产生的绝对相对错误(Yang等人,2025b)。 TAE假设一个静态场景,不计算独立移动的物体.

blocks.en:
TAE is ambiguous at occlusions, which can result in non-zero TAE for ground-truth depth and predictions that attain lower errors than the ground truth, demonstrated in Table 12 .
Further non-zero TAE for ground-truth depth can stem from imprecise depth annotations ( e.g ., from a Kinect sensor), meaning methods may be penalized for better depth coverage. (We define jitter relative to the ground truth, which circumvents this problem.)
On Sintel and Spring, the depth annotations are sufficiently dense and high-quality that we compute a mask to exclude dynamic content and occlusions, whereas the depth of ScanNet, Bonn, and KITTI is sparse and/or low-quality.
blocks.zh:
TAE在封存时模棱两可,可能导致地面真相深度和预测的非零TAE,其误差低于地面真相,如表12所示。
地面真实深度的进一步非零TAE可能源于不准确的深度说明(例如,来自Kinect传感器),意义方法可能因深度范围扩大而受到惩罚。 (我们定义了与地面真相相对的焦虑,从而避免了这个问题。 )
在Sintel和Spring上,深度说明足够密集和高质量,我们计算出一个面具以排除动态内容和隐蔽,而ScanNet、波恩和KITTI的深度则很少和/或质量低。

The ground-truth and blurred-depth reference rows are excluded from the average rank, as are any non-zero-shot results (which appear grayed-out). blocks.zh: 评估协议。 我们评价深度制导的bokeh渲染,在物体边界附近的深度误差会产生可见的前地-后地混合文物. 我们把渲染器固定,只改变其输入深度,从而评价每个估计器的下游用途,而不是比较端到端的bokeh生成系统.

blocks.en: We use the 220 test scenes from RealBokeh ( Seizinger et al., 2025 ) , each containing an f / 22 f/22 source image and a corresponding real f / 2 f/2 photograph. For each source image, we estimate metric depth and provide inverse metric depth to a frozen BokehMe renderer ( Peng et al., 2022 ) . For Depth Pro 2, we convert focal-normalized disparity using its predicted focal length; baselines are converted according to their native metric representations. We apply no depth renormalization or per-image alignment. Non-metric methods are excluded because their missing scale and shift cannot be recovered without scene-specific fitting. We also exclude MetricAnything, which requires a supplied focal length to produce metric depth, whereas no camera intrinsics are provided to any method in this study.
blocks.zh: 我们使用来自RealBokeh的220个试验场景(Seiger等人,2025年),每个场景包含f / 22 f/22源图像和相应的真f / 2 f/2照片. 对于每个源图像,我们估计测量深度,并向一个冷冻的BokehMe渲染器提供反测量深度(Peng等人,2022年)。 就深度方案2而言,我们利用预测的焦距来转换焦态差异;基线根据它们本身的度量表示来转换。 我们没有进行深度的再正常化或逐象对齐. 不包括非计量方法,因为没有具体场景的装配,其缺失的尺度和转变就无法恢复。 我们还排除了任何计量标准,它要求提供焦距以产生度量深度,而本研究中的任何方法都不提供摄像头。

blocks.en: All images are rendered and evaluated at 2000 × 1500 2000\mathbin{\!\times\!}1500 resolution. The renderer and all its parameters are fixed across methods, including one global disparity multiplier selected on a disjoint validation set of 60 scenes. No parameters are fitted on the test set.
blocks.zh: 所有图像在2000×15002000\ mathbin\!\times\!}1500解析度时都会被渲染和评估. 渲染器及其所有参数都固定在各种方法之间,包括在60幕的断开式验证集上选择一个全球差异乘数。 测试集中没有安装参数 。

blocks.en: Boundary LPIPS. This band is derived solely from the f / 22 f/22 source and f / 2 f/2 target images and is therefore identical across methods. We first exposure-align the target luma to the source using a global affine least-squares fit. For each image, we compute local high-frequency energy as E = box 15 ​ ( ( ∇ 2 ℓ ) 2 ) E=\mathrm{box}_{15}((\nabla^{2}\ell)^{2}) . Pixels whose source energy exceeds its 60th percentile are classified as in focus when ρ = E tgt / ( E tgt + E src ) ≥ 0.25 \rho=E_{\mathrm{tgt}}/(E_{\mathrm{tgt}}+E_{\mathrm{src}})\geq 0.25 . We close the resulting mask with a 9-pixel elliptical element, retain its largest 8-connected component, and fill its holes. Boundary LPIPS is the mean spatial LPIPS within eight pixels of the resulting boundary on either side, obtained using an exact Euclidean distance transform.

Birgin LPIPS是两侧产生的边界的八像素内的平均空间LPIPS,使用精确的欧几利得距离变换法获得.

blocks.en: Results. Depth Pro 2-H + performs best across all five metrics. Relative to Depth Anything 3-NGL at 504 × 378 504\times 378 , the strongest baseline on four of the five metrics, it improves PSNR by 0.50 0.50 dB and reduces global and Boundary LPIPS by 4.9 % 4.9\% and 5.6 % 5.6\% , respectively. Relative to Depth Pro, it improves PSNR by 0.75 0.75 dB and reduces the two LPIPS measures by 8.8 % 8.8\% and 10.1 % 10.1\% . These results indicate that the metric depth and camera calibration produced by Depth Pro 2 provide more effective guidance near defocus boundaries. This single-image benchmark does not assess temporal consistency.
blocks.zh: 结果。 深度 Pro 2-H + 在所有五个度量中表现最好。 相对于深度 Anything 3-NGL,在504×378 504\times 378,5个度量中4个度量中最强的基准,它改进了PSNR 0.50 0.50 dB,并分别将全球和边界的LPIPs减少4.9% 4.9\%和5.6% 5.6\%. 相对于深度Pro,它改进了PSNR0.75 0.75 dB,并将两项LPIPS措施减少了8.8% 8.8\%和10.1\%. 这些结果表明,深度方案2生产的度量深度和相机校准在离焦点边界附近提供了更有效的指导。 这一单一图像基准不评估时间一致性。

blocks.en: D.2 Novel-view synthesis
blocks.zh: D.2 小说-视图综合

blocks.en:
We qualitatively compare Depth Pro 2 to Depth Anything 3-G ( Lin et al., 2026 ) , MoGe-2 ( Wang et al., 2025d ) , and UniK3D ( Piccinelli et al., 2025a ) on novel view synthesis.
As the novel view renderer, we employ Tiled Multiplane Image renderer ( Khan et al., 2023 ) with its released weights and the 4-plane setup.
As the renderer requires a disparity map with each image, we convert each method’s prediction accordingly.
We clamp the disparities to [ 0.01,100 ] [0.01,100] , then min-max normalize it to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] per image.
To demonstrate each model’s utility for high-resolution novel view synthesis, we selected images from DIS5K ( Qin et al., 2022 ) , a dataset of high-resolution photographs with thin structures that are sensitive to depth-boundary errors.
When applicable, we downscale each input image with bilinear interpolation to 4096px on the long side.
The camera uses fixed intrinsics ( f = 0.58 ​ W f=0.58W , with principal point at the image center).
We keep the input image, rendering parameters, and camera fixed across methods and only change the disparity predictor.

我们把深度Pro 2 与深度Anything 3-G(Lin等人,2026年),MOGe-2(Wang等人,2025d年),以及UniK3D(Piccinelli等人,2025a年)关于新观点综合的比较.
作为新颖的景观渲染器,我们使用倾斜多飞机图像渲染器(Khan等人,2023年),其释放的重量和四飞机布置.
由于渲染器需要与每个图像的差价映射,我们相应转换每种方法的预测.
我们把差距缩小到[0.01,100] [0.01,100],然后将每幅图像的分数改为[0, 1][0,1]。
为了展示每个模型对高分辨率新颖视图合成的效用,我们从DIS5K(秦等人,2022年)中选择了图像,这是一套高分辨率照片的数据集,其结构较薄,对深度边界误差很敏感.
在适用的情况下,我们将每个输入图像的双线插值缩小到长边的4096px。
相机采用固定的内在(f = 0.58 W = 0.58 W),主点位于图像中心.
我们保持输入图像,渲染参数, 和相机固定跨方法, 并且只改变差异预测器。

blocks.en: E.1 Design choices
blocks.zh: E.1 设计选择

blocks.en: Setup. Each condition changes the baseline training recipe along one axis. We evaluate every condition on the held-out validation sequences of Appendix F.4 : Waymo and ARKitScenes for depth accuracy, and DynamicReplica for boundary sharpness and temporal consistency. Only condition D1 trains on ARKitScenes; for every other condition, ARKitScenes measures generalization to an unseen dataset. The baseline (A1) is a ViT-L model trained for 100K steps on 8 GPUs. We train A1 with 3 random seeds and report the mean and standard deviation; every other condition is trained once. Table 19 lists all results.

blocks.en: Model and batch size. Increasing the number of GPUs from 8 (A1) to 128 (B3) multiplies the batch size, and thus the number of samples seen in 100K steps, by 16 and improves every metric except metric δ 1 \delta_{1} on ARKitScenes. At 128 GPUs, every metric improves monotonically with model size, from Depth Pro 2-S (B1) to Depth Pro 2-H + (B4).

blocks.en: Training data. Our training data combine external datasets and internal data, and both contain synthetic and real-world parts. We vary this mix in four ways: adding real-world data (D1), removing all real-world data (D2), removing all external data (D3), and removing all internal data (D4). D1 adds Objectron ( Ahmadyan et al., 2021 ) , Argoverse2 ( Wilson et al., 2021 ) , MapFree ( Arnold et al., 2022 ) , the training sequences of ARKitScenes ( Dehghan et al., 2021 ) , WayveScenes101 ( Zürn et al., 2024 ) , TartanRGBT ( Maheshwari et al., 2026 ) , the Aria captures (ADT ( Pan et al., 2023 ) , HOT3D ( Banerjee et al., 2025 ) , Nymeria ( Ma et al., 2024 ) , and Reading in the Wild ( Yang et al., 2025a ) ), and additional internal real-world captures.
blocks.zh: 培训数据。 我们的训练数据结合了外部数据集和内部数据,两者都包含合成部分和现实世界部分. 我们以四种方式改变这种组合:添加现实世界数据(D1),删除所有真实世界数据(D2),删除所有外部数据(D3),删除所有内部数据(D4). D1增加了Objectron(Ahmadyan等人,2021年),Argoverse2 (Wilson等人,2021年),《自由地图》 (Arnold等人,2022年),ARKitScenes的训练序列(Dehghan等人,2021年),WayveScenes101(Zürn等人,2024年),TartanRGBT (Maheshwari等人,2026年),阿里亚人捕获(ADT(Pan等人,2023年),HOT3D(Banerjee等人,2025年),Nymeria。 (马等,2024年),"野外的读书"(杨等,2025a),以及额外的内部真实世界的捕捉.

blocks.en: Adding real-world data (D1) improves depth accuracy but smooths boundaries. We attribute the smoothing to the ground truth of real-world datasets, which comes from depth sensors and is often inaccurate at occlusion boundaries. Consistent with this, removing all real-world data (D2) sharpens boundaries beyond the baseline but degrades depth accuracy. Training on internal data only (D3) degrades every metric. Removing all internal data (D4) improves accuracy on Waymo, sharpens boundaries, and lowers jitter, but lowers metric δ 1 \delta_{1} on ARKitScenes by 45.2 percentage points. Internal data thus improves generalization to ARKitScenes, the one validation dataset outside the training mix, at some cost in boundary sharpness and temporal consistency.
blocks.zh: 添加现实世界数据(D1)可以提高深度精度但平滑边界. 我们把真实世界数据集的平滑度归结为地面真理,这些数据来自深度传感器,在隔离边界上往往不准确. 与此一致的是,删除所有现实世界数据(D2)会使边界超越基线,但降低深度精确度。 仅关于内部数据(D3)的培训可降低每个度量。 移除所有内部数据(D4)可以提高Waymo的准确性,缩短边界,降低焦急度,但降低ARKitScens的度量衡 \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\ n45.2个百分点。 因此,内部数据改进了对ARKitScens的概括,这是培训组合之外的一种验证数据集,在边界锐度和时间一致性方面付出了一定的代价。

blocks.en:
Training resolution. The baseline (A1) trains on crops of any aspect ratio at native scale and subsamples some crops with a stride of 2, which adds lower-resolution views without interpolating the ground truth. Removing the strided subsampling (E1) slightly improves accuracy but degrades boundary sharpness. Training only on square crops at native scale
(E2) preserves most of the sharpness but lowers metric δ 1 \delta_{1} on Waymo by 46.6 percentage points. Waymo frames have aspect ratios of 3:2 and about 2.2:1, which suggests that the model needs varied aspect ratios and fields of view in training to recover metric scale. Resizing the square crops to 1536 × 1536 1536\times 1536 , as Depth Pro ( Bochkovskii et al., 2025 ) does (E3), lowers boundary sharpness further, consistent with the benefit of training at native resolution.

培训决议。 基线(A1)列车在原生规模上以任何侧面比例的作物上进行试验,并对一些作物进行分样,分样速度为2,这增加了低分辨率的视图,而没有插入地面的真相. 移除斜纹子采样(E1)会略微提高精度,但会降低边界的锐度. 只对当地规模的方块作物进行培训
(E2)在Waymo上保留了大部分的锐度,但将公尺×××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××× Waymo框架的侧面比为3:2,大约为2.2:1,这表明模型在培训中需要不同的侧面比和视野来恢复度量尺度. 如Depth Pro(Bochkovskii等人,2025年)所做的那样(E3年),将方块作物调整到1536×1536 1536\times 1536 1536 /times 1536,与本土分辨率训练的好处一致,进一步降低边界锐度.

blocks.en: Backbone. Replacing the pretrained DINOv3 backbone with DINOv2 ViT-L/14 (H1) slightly lowers jitter but lowers metric δ 1 \delta_{1} on ARKitScenes by 12.8 points. Freezing DINOv3 (H2) degrades every metric.
blocks.zh: 后b骨. 在ARKitScenes上,用DINOv2 VIT-L/14(H1)取代预训的DINOv3主干线,略微降低颤抖度,但降低公制的~~1\delta_{1}以12.8分. 冻结DINOv3(H2)可降解每个度量.

blocks.en: Training losses. Removing the multi-view consistency loss (I1) raises jitter by 0.05. Replacing our gradient loss with the first-order boundary loss of Depth Pro (I2), which computes the same gradient error at 6 scales instead of 3, lowers boundary F1 by 3.5 percentage points. The full set of Depth Pro boundary losses (I3), which adds second-order and squared-gradient terms to I2, lowers boundary F1 by 3.8 percentage points and lowers metric δ 1 \delta_{1} on Waymo by 3.3 points. Weighting our inverse-depth losses by predicted confidence (I4), as feed-forward reconstruction methods do, lowers boundary F1 by 6.8 points. We hypothesize that the model is least certain at boundaries, so confidence weighting lets it discount the loss exactly where it must learn to resolve them.
blocks.zh: 培训损失。 消除多视图一致性损失(I1)会增加0.05。 以深度Pro(I2)的第一阶边界损失取代梯度损失,后者计算出6级而不是3级的同一梯度错误,将边界F1降低3.5个百分点。 在Waymo上,全集深度Pro边界损失(I3)在I2上增加了二阶值和平方梯度值,将边界F1下调3.8个百分点,将公尺××1\delta××1}下调3.3分. 通过预测的信心(I4)来权衡我们反向的深度损失,就像向前进的重建方法那样,将边界F1降低6.8点。 我们假设模型在边界上至少是肯定的, 所以信心的加权可以让模型在它必须学会解决它们的地方, 将损失打折扣。

blocks.en: E.2 Inference-time analysis
blocks.zh: E.2 推断时间分析

blocks.en: We study how the trained Depth Pro 2-H + behaves at inference time, without retraining. Both studies use the held-out validation windows of Appendix F.4 . The cross-frame attention study (Table 20 ) uses DynamicReplica, which provides the ground-truth optical flow that jitter requires. The resolution study (Table 21 ) uses all three datasets.
blocks.zh: 我们研究训练有素的Pro 2-H + 如何在推论时间表现,而不进行再培训. 这两项研究都使用附录F.4的搁置验证窗口。 跨帧注意力研究(表20)采用动态视网膜(Dynamic Replica),提供焦急所需的地面真光学流. 分辨率研究(表21)使用了所有三个数据集。

blocks.en:
Cross-frame attention vs. temporal consistency. To probe the causal relationship between the cross-frame attention mechanism and temporal consistency, we randomly drop connections between frames with a certain probability.
The dropout pattern is consistent across cross-frame attention blocks throughout a forward pass.
We repeat three times with different dropout patterns and report the mean and standard deviation.
We report metric depth accuracy, relative depth accuracy, boundary F1, and jitter in Table 20 .
As we remove more connections, jitter rises monotonically from 0.24 to 0.84.
This suggests the cross-frame attention mechanism is key to our model for temporally consistent depth estimation.
In addition, sharpness also degrades as more connections are dropped, suggesting
the model uses information from other frames to predict sharp boundaries as well.
blocks.zh:
跨框架关注与时间一致性。 为了探究跨帧关注机制与时间一致性之间的因果关系,我们随机在帧之间降下一定概率的连接.
在整个前方通道中,跨框架关注块的辍学模式是一致的。
我们以不同的退学模式重复三次,并报告平均和标准偏差。
我们在表20中报告测量深度准确度、相对深度准确度、边界F1和紧张度。
随着我们去除更多的连接,焦躁单调地从0.24上升到0.84.
这表明跨框架关注机制是我们时间一致性深度估计模型的关键。
此外,尖锐性也随着连接的减少而降低,这表明
模型使用其他框架的信息来预测尖锐的边界。

blocks.en: Table 20 : Cross-frame attention vs temporal consistency. We evaluate Depth Pro 2-H + on 32-frame clips from DynamicReplica, while randomly dropping cross-frame attention between pairs of frames. All blocks follow the same dropout pattern throughout the forward pass. We report metrics over three draws. Jitter rises steadily as more connections are removed. We evaluate both inference modes (Section 3.3 ) on 300-frame DynamicReplica sequences. We provide ground-truth intrinsics, so metric accuracy reflects depth estimation alone and excludes errors from focal length estimation. blocks.en: Buffered streaming processes a video that exceeds the memory of a single forward pass as a sequence of clips. Figure 10 (solid blue) shows the effect of the clip length N N and the overlap K K between consecutive clips.

blocks.en: Clip length. Longer clips improve temporal consistency and boundary accuracy. Without overlap, increasing N N from 1 to 64 frames reduces jitter from 0.860 to 0.280 and raises boundary F1 from 53.5% to 58.0%. Most of the gain comes early: 8-frame clips account for more than 85% of the reduction in jitter. Jitter keeps decreasing up to N = 64 N=64 , twice the longest training clip, and a single pass over all 300 frames matches this level (0.279) at a peak memory of 151.5 GiB and 3.5 FPS. Peak memory grows with N N , and throughput decreases with N N from 2-frame clips onward.

blocks.en:
Unbuffered streaming immediately processes each input frame upon arrival.
During the processing, the cross-attention layers attend over a window of C C frames: the current frame and the C − 1 C-1 frames before it, whose keys and values are cached. Figure 10 (dashed orange) shows how changing C C affects performance.
We find that increasing the cache size improves temporal consistency: jitter drops from 0.860 with a single frame to 0.300 at 16 frames and levels off at 0.289 from 32, the length of the longest training clip. Beyond C = 16 C=16 , jitter improves by at most 5%.
Boundary F1 follows the same trend, while metric and relative δ 1 \delta_{1} stay between 98.8% and 99.2% for all cache sizes. Each cached frame adds a roughly constant cost of about 1.14 ms in latency and 0.19 GiB in peak memory, from 44 ms and 10.6 GiB at C = 16 C=16 to 62 ms and 13.7 GiB at C = 32 C=32 . We therefore recommend C = 16 C=16 as the default.

blocks.en: E.4 Focal-length estimator
blocks.zh: E.4 焦距估计器

blocks.en:
Separate estimator vs. bespoke head per depth model. We explored several ways to estimate focal length for our family of Depth Pro 2 models.
One attractive option is to attach a small, trainable FoV head to each depth model’s frozen encoder, which adds negligible compute by reusing depth encoder features during a forward pass.
This works well on Depth Pro 2-H + : a 1.9M-parameter transformer head reaches a mean δ 25 \delta_{25} of 86.5% (Table 23 ).
On the smaller models, however, this approach does not reach satisfactory accuracy.
The same head on Depth Pro 2-S reaches only 74.5%, and a head eight times larger still falls short (78.8%).
This motivates us to use a single separate estimator for all four models (88.6%).
A separate estimator costs one extra forward pass, at a capped 512-pixel short side, and 23.5M extra parameters.
In return, we can ensure every Depth Pro 2 model receives the same focal length for a given image, and the estimator does not need to be retrained when the depth models change.
blocks.zh:
独立估计器和每个深度模型的声头 我们探索了几种方法来估计 我们的深度Pro 2模型家族的焦距。
一个有吸引力的选择是在每个深度模型的冷冻编码器上加装一个小的,可训练的FOV头,通过在前方通过时重用深度编码器特性来增加可忽略不计的计算.
这在深度Pro 2-H +:1.9M参数的变压器头达到86.5%的平均值(表23)。
然而,在较小的模型上,这种方法并不达到令人满意的准确性。
深度Pro 2-S的同一头只达到74.5%,一个8倍大的头仍然不足(78.8%).
这促使我们对所有四个模型(88.6%)使用一个单独的估计器。
一个单独的估测器额外需要1个前传,在512像素短边的上限,以及23.5M的额外参数.
作为回报,我们可以确保每个深度Pro 2模型都得到给定图像相同的焦距,当深度模型改变时,估计器不需要重新训练.

blocks.en: Model size. Our focal-length estimator uses ViT-S, the smallest DINOv3 backbone. Under a simple recipe ( 256 × 256 256\times 256 input and a linear head on the mean patch token), FoV δ 25 \delta_{25} grows steadily with backbone size (Figure 11 ). It does so with slightly less compute than ViT-L and a third of the compute of ViT-H + , and with 13 × 13\times and 36 × 36\times fewer parameters. blocks.en: Input resolution and aspect ratio. The estimator processes each image at its native aspect ratio. We train with a single 512-pixel short side, the resolution at which an earlier multi-resolution model was most accurate. At test time, the estimator is stable for short sides between 384 and 768 pixels and degrades outside that range: mean δ 25 \delta_{25} is 80.1% at 256, 86.9% at 384, 88.6% at 512, 87.3% at 768, and 84.9% at 1024. We therefore resize test images with a short side above 512 pixels to 512, round the short side down to a multiple of 32, and never upsample smaller images, because upsampling them has mixed effects ( + 5.6 +5.6 δ 25 \delta_{25} on PPR10K, − 6.0 -6.0 on iBims).

F.2 Zero-shot evaluation details

blocks.en: Zero-shot status. We show a result in gray when the evaluated checkpoint was trained on the evaluation dataset. Gray entries are excluded from the per-dataset ranks and from the average ranks across datasets, so the average rank of a method with gray entries covers only the datasets on which it is zero-shot.

blocks.en: Single-image and video settings. Depth Pro 2 accepts both single frames and multi-frame clips, as do several baselines. Most other baselines accept only single images. DepthCrafter, VeloDepth and Video Depth Anything accept only clips, and VeloDepth reduces to UniK3D on a single frame. To compare both kinds of method fairly, we evaluate metric depth and boundary sharpness in two settings. In the single-image setting, every method receives one frame at a time. On video and multi-view datasets, we predict and score each of the first 50 frames of a sequence as a separate image, and methods estimate the focal length for every frame independently. In the video setting, every method receives the first 50 frames of a sequence as one clip. Video methods process the clip jointly, and single-image methods process its frames independently. We evaluate temporal consistency in the video setting only. The boundary metric of Bochkovskii et al. (2025) and our temporal-consistency metrics are scale-invariant, so we also evaluate methods that predict only relative depth on them.
blocks.zh: 单图和视频设置. 深度Pro 2既接受单帧剪辑,也接受多帧剪辑,几个基线也是如此. 大部分其他基线只接受单一图像. 深度Crafter,Velo深度和Video深度Anything只接受剪辑,Velo深度在单帧上缩小为UniK3D. 为了公平地比较这两种方法,我们评价两种情况下的测量深度和边界锐度。 在单像设定中,每种方法一次得到一个帧. 在视频和多视图数据集上,我们预测和评分一个序列的前50帧中的每一帧作为单独的图像,方法分别估计每个帧的焦距. 在视频设定中,每一种方法都以一个片段的方式接收序列的前50帧. 视频方法联合处理剪辑,单图像方法独立处理其帧. 我们只评价录像中的时间一致性。 Bochkovskii等人(2025年)的边界度量度和我们的时间一致性度量度量度都是尺度-变量的,因此我们也评价了仅预测其相对深度的方法.

blocks.en: Baseline evaluation. We evaluate all baselines from their released checkpoints with the protocols in this section, unless noted otherwise. Our scores may differ from published results, because studies differ in camera intrinsics, alignment procedures, sampled frames or sequences, and evaluation resolution.
blocks.zh: 基线评价。 除非另有说明,否则我们用本节中的议定书评估这些检查站的所有基线。 我们的分数可能与公布的结果不同,因为研究在相机内在,对齐程序,抽样帧或序列,评价分辨率等方面有所不同.

blocks.en: Evaluation splits. Lin et al. (2026) and Piccinelli et al. (2025a) evaluate on the indoor split of DIODE ( Vasiljevic et al., 2019 ) only. We evaluate on the full validation split, indoor and outdoor. The outdoor scenes are harder, so our DIODE scores are lower than those reported on the indoor split. We use the official DIODE validity mask for every metric. For nuScenes, we use the evaluation split of Bochkovskii et al. (2025) , and for HAMMER, the split of Kong et al. (2026) . Both splits consist of individual frames, so we evaluate them in the single-image setting only.
blocks.zh: 评价有分歧。 Lin等人(2026年)和Piccinelli等人(2025年a)仅评价DIODE(Vasiljevic等人,2019年)的室内分裂. 我们评估在室内和室外的完全验证。 户外场景更难,所以我们的DIODE得分低于室内拆分报告. 我们使用官方的DIODE有效性面具 每一个度量。 对nuScenes来说,我们使用Bochkovskii等人(2025年)的评价分数,对HAMMER来说,Kong等人(2026年)的评价分数。 两种分裂都由单个帧组成,所以我们只在单像设定中评价它们.

blocks.en: F.3 Baseline configurations
blocks.zh: F.3 基线配置

blocks.en: Common input. We evaluate every method on the same frames: one contiguous clip of the first 50 frames per video sequence, sampled at stride one. Prior work samples frames, sets clip lengths, and aligns predictions in different ways, so published video-depth results are hard to compare directly. For example, VGGT- Ω \Omega evaluates 10 randomly sampled frames per sequence ( Wang et al., 2026a , §4) . Video Depth Anything evaluates up to 500 frames per video, reports 90- and 110-frame settings for comparison with DepthCrafter, and aligns predictions in inverse-depth space ( Chen et al., 2025 ) . The one exception to our common input is the temporal alignment evaluation on ScanNet (Table 12 ), where we use the 170-frame clips of the Video Depth Anything evaluation ( Chen et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 常见投入. 我们在同一帧上评估每一种方法:每个视频序列前50帧的一个毗连片段,在第一步取样。 先前的工作样本帧,设定剪辑长度,并以不同方式对预测进行对齐,因此公布的视频深度结果很难直接比较. 例如,VGGT - 堆积 \ Omega 评估每个序列的10个随机抽样帧(Wang et al., 2026a , §fact). 视频深度 任何东西都对每段视频最多500帧的评价,报告90帧和110帧的设置,以便与DepthCrafter进行比较,并对反向深度空间的预测进行校正(Chen等人,2025年)。 我们共同投入的一个例外是ScanNet上的时间调整评价(表12),我们使用视频深度Anything评价的170帧剪辑(Chen等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Clip processing. Each method processes the clip with its official inference procedure. Methods that accept 50 frames receive the whole clip in one pass; the others use their released windowing, e.g . , Video Depth Anything processes 32-frame windows. On ScanNet, Depth Pro 2-H + runs in buffered streaming with clips of N = 64 N=64 frames and an overlap of K = 32 K=32 .
blocks.zh: 剪贴处理. 每种方法都用官方推论程序处理剪辑。 接受50帧的方法在一个通道中接收整个剪辑;其他方法则使用其释放的窗口,例如,Video Depth Anything处理32帧窗口. 在ScanNet上,深度Pro 2-H+在缓冲流中运行,片断为N=64 N=64帧,重叠为K=32 K=32帧.

blocks.en: Input resolution. We retain each method’s official inference resolution because changing it can affect metric accuracy, boundary sharpness, temporal consistency, and runtime. For example, Depth Pro resizes every frame to 1536 × 1536 1536\times 1536 . Some methods crop the input in their official preprocessing ( e.g . , VGGT- Ω \Omega ). For these methods, we pad each frame so that the crop removes only padding, and then remove the padding from the prediction. Every method is thus evaluated on the same image region.
blocks.zh: 输入分辨率。 我们保留了每种方法的官方推论分辨率,因为改变它会影响测量精确度、边界锐度、时间一致性和运行时间。 例如,深度方案将每个帧调整为1536×1536×1536\时 1536 (英语). 一些方法在官方预处理中裁剪输入(例如,VGGT-ship\Omega ). 对于这些方法,我们贴上每个框架,使裁剪只去掉贴,然后从预测中去掉贴. 因此,每种方法都在同一图像区域进行评估。

blocks.en: Output resizing. Because methods differ in their internal preprocessing, their predictions may not match the spatial resolution of the ground truth. In such cases, we resize the prediction to the ground-truth resolution using nearest-neighbor interpolation, thereby avoiding additional smoothing at depth discontinuities.
blocks.zh: 输出调整大小 。 由于其内部预处理方法不同,其预测可能与地面真理的空间分辨率不符. 在这种情况下,我们利用最近的邻里插值,将预测调整为地面真实分辨率,从而避免在深度不连续的情况下出现更多的平滑。

blocks.en: Affine alignment. Before computing relative-depth accuracy, boundary F1, and temporal consistency, we align each prediction to the ground truth with a scale and a shift. We align every method this way, including metric-depth models and Depth Pro 2, so that these metrics measure the structure of a prediction independently of its metric scale. For relative-depth accuracy (Tables 10 and 11 ) and boundary F1 (Table 4 ), we fit the scale and shift for each frame separately, also when a method predicts the frames of a clip jointly. For jitter (Table 5 ) and TAE (Table 12 ), we fit one scale and shift per video, which preserves the variation in scale across frames that these metrics measure.
blocks.zh: Affine对齐. 在计算相对深入的准确性,边界F1和时间一致性之前,我们将每个预测都与地面的真相与尺度和变化一致. 我们以这种方式调整每一种方法,包括测量深度模型和深度Pro 2,以便这些测量尺度衡量一个预测的结构独立于其测量尺度。 为了相对深入的精确度(表10和11)和边界F1(表4),我们分别为每个帧配上比例尺和移位,当一种方法共同预测一个剪辑的帧时也是如此. 对于抖动(表5)和TAE(表12),我们每个视频安装一个比例尺并进行转换,这保持了这些衡量尺度所衡量的跨帧比例的变化。

blocks.en:
By default, we fit the scale and shift in inverse-depth space by trimmed least squares: we keep the 80% of sampled valid pixels with the smallest squared residuals. Three methods output log depth (Lapis, Pixel-Perfect Depth, and Marigold V2). Following their evaluation protocols, we fit these methods in log-depth space with the same trimming.
Tables 4(a) , 4(b) , and 5 mark them with “(log)”.
blocks.zh:
默认情况下,我们通过修剪最小方块来适应尺度和向反深空间的转变:我们保留80%的抽样有效像素,并保留最小的方块残基. 三种方法输出日志深度(Lapis、像素-完美深度和Marigold V2)。 根据他们的评估协议,我们将这些方法放在日志的深度空间中,并进行同样的修剪。
表4(a),4(b)和5将其标为“log”。

blocks.en: F.4 Held-out validation
blocks.zh: F.4 联合国 已停用验证

blocks.en: The controlled experiments (Appendix E ), the inference-time analysis studies (Appendix E.2 ), and the long-video evaluation (Appendix E.3 ) use held-out validation sequences from three datasets that do not appear in the zero-shot evaluation: Waymo ( Sun et al., 2020 ) (real, outdoor; 42 sequences at 1280 × 1920 1280\times 1920 or 886 × 1920 886\times 1920 ), ARKitScenes ( Dehghan et al., 2021 ) (real, indoor; 92 sequences at 1440 × 1920 1440\times 1920 ), and DynamicReplica ( Karaev et al., 2023 ) (synthetic; 44 sequences at 720 × 1280 720\times 1280 ). We train on the training sequences of Waymo and DynamicReplica, and on those of ARKitScenes only in condition D1 of the controlled experiments. Conditions D2 and D3 leave out Waymo and D3 also DynamicReplica. We hold out 5% of the data shards of each dataset from training, selected by a fixed hash. Of the 46 held-out DynamicReplica sequences, we discard two in which the camera passes through scene geometry: over part of each sequence, the ground truth contains a surface a few centimeters from the camera that the image does not show.

blocks.en: From each sequence, we take one window of up to 32 consecutive frames, starting at a seeded random frame, and process it in a single forward pass, at native resolution unless a study varies the input size. The long-video evaluation instead uses the first 300 frames of each sequence.
blocks.zh: 从每个序列中,我们取一个最多32个连续帧的窗口,从一个种子随机帧开始,用一个单一的前传处理,以原生分辨率处理,除非研究会改变输入大小. 长视频评价则使用每个序列的前300帧.

blocks.en: We report four metrics: metric δ 1 \delta_{1} with the ground-truth focal length; relative δ 1 \delta_{1} after a per-frame affine fit in inverse-depth space; the boundary F1 of Bochkovskii et al. (2025) ; and, on DynamicReplica, jitter (Eq. F.1 ) along point tracks obtained by chaining the ground-truth optical flow.
blocks.zh: 我们报告四个衡量标准:具有地面真象焦距的度量度为1\delta{1};在每帧近缘符合反深度空间后相对为1\delta{1};Bochkovskii等人(2025年)的边界F1;通过连锁地面真象光学流而获得的点轨线上的动态Replica、jitter(Eq.F.1)。

blocks.en: F.5 Runtime measurement
blocks.zh: F.5 运行时间测量

blocks.en: Setup. We measure the runtime of Depth Pro 2 in Figures 10 and 12 with our code release on one B200 GPU, in eager PyTorch without torch.compile , with cuDNN attention (the PyTorch default on this GPU). The backbone and decoder run under bf16 autocast, and the depth head runs in fp32. The inputs are synthetic 16:9 frames. The focal length is given, so the field-of-view network is excluded from the timings. Each configuration, defined by the model, the input size, and N N and K K or C C , runs in its own process. We run each configuration 3 times and report the median across runs.
blocks.zh: 设置. 我们在图10和图12中测量深度 Pro 2 的运行时间, 我们的代码发布在一个 B200 GPU上, 在急切的 PyTorch 没有火炬. compile 中, 有 cuDNN 的注意( 这个 GPU上的 PyTorch 默认) 。 骨干和解码器运行在bf16自动广播下,深度头运行在fp32. 投入为合成16:9帧. 指定了焦距,因此视域网络被排除在计时之外. 每个配置,由模型,输入大小,以及N N和K K 或 C C 定义,在自己的过程中运行. 我们运行每个配置3次 并报告中位数横跨运行。

blocks.en: Timing. We time two operations: a buffered pass over a clip of N N frames, and an unbuffered step with a full cache of C C frames. Each time is the median of 20 calls after 2 warm-up calls. Latency and throughput follow from these times.
blocks.zh: 时机 我们时间为两个操作:一个缓冲通过一个N帧的片段,另一个是C帧的全缓存的未缓冲步骤. 每一次是两次热身电话后20个电话的中位数. 短暂性和吞吐量来自这些时代。

blocks.en: Latency. Latency is the time from the arrival of a frame from a 30 fps camera to the availability of its depth map. In unbuffered streaming, each frame is processed on arrival, so its latency is the time of one step. This assumes that the GPU is idle when the frame arrives, which holds when throughput is at least 30 fps; at lower throughput, the frames of a live camera queue up or must be dropped.
blocks.zh: 即时. latency是从一个帧从30英尺摄像头到其深度图的可用时间. 在无缓冲的流体中,每个帧在到达时都会得到处理,因此其缓冲性是一步的时间. 这假设GPU在帧到达时是闲置的,当吞吐量至少为30英尺/秒时,它会保持;在较低的吞吐量时,一个活相机队列的帧会向上或必须掉落.

blocks.en:
Throughput. Throughput is the number of frames finalized per second on a long video.
In buffered streaming, each pass finalizes N − K N-K frames, so throughput is N − K N-K divided by the time of one pass. In unbuffered streaming, it is one divided by the time of one step.
blocks.zh:
吞吐量. 吞吐量是长视频上每秒最后确定的帧数.
在缓冲流流中,每段流经都会最终确定N−K N−K帧,因此吞吐量是N−K N−K除以一次流经的时间. 在无阻流中,它是一个除以一步的时间.

blocks.en: Peak memory. Peak memory is the maximum memory reserved by PyTorch’s caching allocator while processing a video, over one warm-up pass and three timed passes. In buffered streaming, the video spans at least two clips, as a long video does: it has 128 frames for clips of up to 64 frames and 2 ​ N 2N frames for N ∈ { 96,128,192 } N\in\{96,128,192\} . The Full variant in Figure 10 uses 300 frames. In unbuffered streaming, the video has 128 frames for every cache size, since the cache is allocated in full on the first frame.
blocks.zh: 峰记. 峰值记忆是PyTorch的胸腔分配器在处理视频时保留的最大内存,超过一个温暖的通道和三个定时通道. 在缓冲流线中,视频至少会像长视频一样横跨两个片段:它拥有128帧的片段,最高可达64帧,2N 2N帧的片段为N {{ 96,128,192}N\in 96,128,192\}. 图10中的全变体使用300帧. 在无缓冲流流中,由于缓存在第一帧上被全部分配,视频每个缓存大小都有128帧.
